description: Run an agent by hand and get back its Run record, including the step log. Works with no model configured — the run class is stamped at dispatch and a runtime error lands as a Failed run rather than an error here, so the absence of an exception does not mean the run succeeded; the returned run says. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES run_agent"]
